title: Grutas de las Palmas - Mafia Maps 2002
credits: Grutas de las Palmas, Q.Roo, Mexico; passage 2,665 pies (feet); exploración y plano Rosendo Cauich, Don Marciano Uc May, Benja Sacristian, Fred Devos, Jose Mis; Mafia Maps, noviembre 2002 (c) F. Devos, 2002
unverified: No cenote of the map has a position: none of its eight cenote pools is named, the map's only names are line names (Main Line, Mi Piatche, Rais Loop, El Brinco, Palo Loop, Raft, Brillante, Little Room), and neither those nor 'Grutas de las Palmas' / 'Palmas' match any cave or sistema of the database (the only Palmas there are Dos Palmas, Nohoch Nah Chich area, and Jailhouse's aka Las Palmas, Tulum South) or any cave/water feature of OpenStreetMap around Playa del Carmen (Overpass name and natural=water/sinkhole/cave_entrance searches, 20.40-20.85 N); a web search found nothing either. The map draws no road, coast or other ground feature. The single control point is a NOMINAL anchor (the largest pool put on Parque Las Palmas in the Las Palmas I neighbourhood of Playa del Carmen, a namesake only - the pools don't match anything on the imagery there) so the pipeline can run: the geometry is NOT on the ground. To fix: field GPS positions of two of its cenotes (e.g. the large pool and the south-east pool, about 120 m apart).
placementWhy: UNVERIFIED (see 'unverified'). Same map as _data/cartes/à traiter/Palmas, Grutas de las, Playa del Carmen.pdf. Scale from the drawn 0-300 pies bar: 1,648 px = 91.44 m, 0.0555 m/px (its 100/200 dividers agree within 2%). Check: the traced lines total about 2,415 ft at that scale against the title block's 'Passage: 2,665 pies' (91%: Mafia line plots are smoothed, and short legs may be missing). North from the compass rose (up), unchecked. Position nominal. Checked and rejected: the two OSM 'Cenote' ponds by the highway north of Playa (20.6730 N, 87.1055 W, an eco-park) are a 110 m lagoon and paired pools, nothing like the map's pools (the largest 28 m). No placed map can overlap it, since its position is unknown.

trace.why: Stick map (Mafia Maps line plot, black guidelines only, no walls): traced as lines, no thickness. The scan is a 4x upscale of a small image: at the default ink level the lines' blurred edges make a jagged skeleton whose tiny spurs split the Mi Piatche line and the Rais Loop's east corner (the joining then dropped the pieces between them, leaving 1-1.5 m gaps in continuous ink); inkLevel 200 takes the whole blurred stroke and gives a clean skeleton. Pools, labels, the compass, the scale bar and the two arrows are masked (the grey pool fills are ink at that level). The large pool is masked in two boxes so the El Brinco line reaches its rim (a ~1 m piece of the rim between the boxes is traced with it). Gaps kept as drawn (jumps): every pool but the large and the south-east ones stands apart from the lines; the Raft line ends free; the Palo Loop line starts free at its west end, linked to the cenote north of Raft only by the double-headed arrow.

symbols.why: Mafia Maps line plot without depths (no overlined, circled or boxed numbers anywhere: checked on the OCR and by eye), letter codes, legend, flow arrows or bones. Line names kept as place names (Main Line three times, as printed). Two arrows: east of Palo Loop a plain arrow (the passage continues, leads-to), and a grey double-headed arrow between the Palo Loop line's west end and the cenote north of Raft (an unsurveyed link - kept as a leads-to at its middle, not drawn as a line). Units ft (pies).
